images.screen: A · 손전등 — 건전지를 태우며 열쇠를 찾는 순간
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame: first-person horror survival in a low-poly, flat-shaded basement boiler room, 16:9. Almost everything is pitch black; a single warm flashlight hotspot with a soft falloff lights a wooden wall shelf where a small brass key glints with a star sparkle beside a cardboard box and a jar, and the edge of a rusty red boiler with a pressure gauge. A faint volumetric cone of light with floating dust runs from a low-poly gloved hand holding a flashlight in the lower right. In the far darkness a small green emergency exit sign glows over a half-open door. HUD: top-left objective and room counter, bottom-left three AA battery cells (one empty, one full, the active one low and blinking red) with a big percentage, bottom-right a noise meter of amber bars, an interaction prompt under the key. Grainy, tense, stylized PS1-meets-modern lighting. Korean UI text: "열쇠를 찾아 나간다", "38%", "열쇠 줍기".

images.screen: B · 소등 — 불을 끄고 소리로만 버티는 순간
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame: the same low-poly boiler room from first person, but the flashlight is off. The room is barely visible in cold desaturated blue-black. The only readable shapes are sound echoes: expanding pale-blue elliptical ripples on the floor where footsteps land, and a glowing thin cyan wireframe outline of a tall, thin, long-armed creature standing in the left doorway, two small red eye points, revealed only by its steps. Faint wireframe lines of the room's edges pulse with each echo. A throbbing dark red heartbeat vignette at the screen edges, a directional sound glow on the left border. HUD: the battery cells dimmed and marked off, a breath-holding progress bar at the bottom center, a spiky audio meter bottom-right. Claustrophobic, silent, clip-worthy tension. Korean UI text: "불을 껐다", "숨 참는 중", "심박 128".
